# Fixtures

Trimmed files of the GDELT 2.0 streams of 2026-11-18, used under the GDELT terms (free use with citation of
the GDELT Project, https://www.gdeltproject.org/). Columns that carry names of persons or free text were
emptied before the files entered the repository: actor names of the event files; persons, quotations, names,
amounts and extras of the GKG. File names follow the spool convention `<slot>.<stream>.<kind>.zip`.
